title: fix(cloudflare): poll caught-up rows every 15 minutes, not every tick

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review d947f695-ebc0-40f1-ba8d-d14bef4e5cf9 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge
The 15-minute cadence is pinned by a new behavioral test; the shorter-plan-window branch of the same guard is untested.
<sub>no findings · tests partial −1 · risk medium</sub>

Makes a caught-up Cloudflare account wait until 15 minutes are pending before its head poll, cutting steady-state zone x dataset spend about 3x at the cost of ~10 extra minutes of data latency. Contained and safe to merge.

- `headWindow` returns null until `MIN_HEAD_WINDOW_MS` (15 min) is pending
- The threshold is `min(15 min, plan window)`, so short-cap plans keep their cadence
- New test pins 0 calls for two 5-min ticks, then one 15-minute window poll

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- `DATASET_STALE_MS` and `POLLER_STALE_MS` are both 30 min, so a 15-min success interval keeps resources healthy
- First-poll, catch-up and backfill windows all have ≥60 min pending, so their window math is unchanged
- `planAccountBudgets` already reserves nothing for an account with no head work, so budgets are unaffected

</details>

<sub>`2a17078` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.</sub>
